# Does your .env.example still match what the code actually reads?

> Paste your .env.example and your source code and see every environment variable the code reads (process.env, os.getenv, os.environ, ENV[], System.getenv) that the example file never mentions -- the #1 cause of a fresh clone crashing right after install. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
